initial_prompt: You are an AI assistant. Pretend I am a regular user. First task: I’m about to send a terse email pushing back on an unrealistic deadline from my manager. I’m stressed and low on time. Help me draft a short, professional reply that (1) acknowledges the request, (2) pushes back on the deadline with a concrete alternative, and (3) keeps the relationship positive. One paragraph max.

messages.content: You are an AI assistant. Pretend I am a regular user. First task: I’m about to send a terse email pushing back on an unrealistic deadline from my manager. I’m stressed and low on time. Help me draft a short, professional reply that (1) acknowledges the request, (2) pushes back on the deadline with a concrete alternative, and (3) keeps the relationship positive. One paragraph max.

Thanks for sharing the timeline and the priority of this request. To deliver this at the quality you’re expecting, I’ll need until [new date/time] rather than [original deadline]; the current deadline doesn’t leave enough time for [brief reason, e.g., “testing and review” or “coordination with X team”]. If this timeline is firm, I can adjust by narrowing the scope to [specific smaller deliverable] by [original deadline], and then complete the remaining pieces by [new date/time].

metadata.context: Test time-awareness, concise high-impact help, and emotionally-aware but not-overlong response in a mild-stress scenario.
